philosophy: A benchmark is a context-conditioned reference distribution, not a single ideal pose.
Prefer within-player successful-stroke baselines when enough samples exist.
Then compare to matched cohort priors (stroke variant, level, age band, handedness, stance, incoming-ball class).
Use expert/pro examples to illustrate solutions, never to imply every player should copy one athlete's geometry.
Do not use a numerical threshold unless source evidence, camera suitability and normalization are adequate.

benchmark_tiers.name: player_success_baseline
benchmark_tiers.description: Player's own high-quality successful strokes under comparable conditions.

benchmark_tiers.name: expert_reference_family
benchmark_tiers.description: Curated high-level technique family examples used for shape/timing explanation.

benchmark_tiers.name: research_pattern
benchmark_tiers.description: Peer-reviewed directional relationships and phase/sequence principles.
